title: Etale open tensor and coefficient comparisons with counit normalization
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes, let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and use constant ring sheaves on small etale sites and their ordinary unbounded module derived categories. Write $j_!$ for exact extension by zero, $j^*$ for exact restriction, and $F_T=-\otimes_A^L B$ on $T=U,X$. For all $P\in D(U_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $T\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ the canonical map
$$\gamma_{P,T}:j_!(P\otimes_A^L j^*T)\longrightarrow j_!P\otimes_A^L T$$
is an isomorphism. It is the $j_!\dashv j^*$-adjunct of the identity under $j^*j_!\cong1$ and the restriction/tensor comparison. On module sheaves the same formula holds for ordinary tensor. Extension by zero preserves flat module sheaves and K-flat complexes. There is a natural $B$-linear isomorphism $q_{j,P}:F_Xj_!P\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!F_UP$ whose restriction to $U$ is the identity under the canonical tensor identifications. Under $F_Uj^*\cong j^*F_X$ it satisfies
$$\epsilon_{j,B,F_XT}\circ j_!(F_Uj^*T\cong j^*F_XT)\circ q_{j,j^*T}=F_X(\epsilon_{j,A,T}).$$
The tensor and scalar comparisons commute with associativity and successive scalar extension under their canonical identifications. All comparisons and the derived adjunction are normalized by degreewise extension of the open sheaf adjunction; no boundedness or constructibility assumption is made.

Notation and categorical conventions are those of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], [def-kun-derived-tensor], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], [def-pc-kflat-complex], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction].

proof.text: Use the canonical interface of [lem-coef-etale-open-comparison-data], including invertibility of the fixed inverse scalar/restriction mate. All ordinary and derived functors and all public statements retain their original definitions.

For the ordinary projection map, its adjunction-transpose description is left-adjoint image followed by the counit. Open extension is fully faithful, and the étale projection isomorphism puts the target in its essential image. The counit and hence the canonical projection map are invertible.

The published derived open projection map is already an isomorphism. Preserve flatness using the published ordinary étale lower-shriek PreservesFlat instance, transported by etaleConstantModule_flat_iff. Apply [lem-coef-etale-open-kflat] to unbounded K-flat complexes.

Take the four scalar normalization and uniqueness fields, the scalar tower field and the mixed tensor/scalar field from [lem-coef-etale-open-scalar-coherence]. This is strictly the coefficient part; it asserts none of projection invertibility, ordinary projection, flatness, K-flat preservation, the open unit/counit identities or tensor associativity.

The inverse open/scalar comparison is the iterated mate of the inverse restriction/scalar square. The iterated-mates/conjugation identity and the unit and counit mate equations give q_restricts and counit. For q_restricts invert the equality of the two composites of unit isomorphisms.

Transport the existing strong monoidal pullback along L(j-star) ≅ D(j-star). Its tensorator is the defined exact restriction tensorator, and its projection map is canonicalGammaExact. Apply the generic adjunction projectionMap_assoc theorem, using lax-monoidal associativity; postcompose with the associator to obtain exactly tensor_associative. This categorical argument is proved over a general coefficient category before specializing to ModuleCat A.
